content.text: {"core": "Change ends what has completed. Seated in its own position, the ending operates on ending itself: the faculty that closes finished forms is the form now due to close. Unacknowledged, the recursion runs unmarked, so the closing keeps closing past its own completion, dismantling structures that had already resolved. Termination outlives its object.", "sheetLine": "The clearing has finished its work; it now takes apart what was already settled."}
